messages.content: Derive the solution of the 1D heat equation on [0, L] with u(0,t)=u(L,t)=0 and u(x,0)=f(x), and state the conditions under which the Fourier series converges uniformly.

Our Kubernetes StatefulSet with a PostgreSQL primary/replica pair loses writes after a node drain. Explain the likely failure modes around fencing and synchronous_commit, and give a corrected configuration.
IFRS 16 と ASC 842 で、セール・アンド・リースバック取引の会計処理がどう異なるか、売却の要件判定から利得の認識まで具体的に説明してください。

量子化誤差を考慮した上で、INT8 の GEMM で FP16 と同等の精度を保つためのスケーリング戦略（per-channel / per-token）を、数式を使って比較してください。

Write a product announcement for our note-taking app. Requirements: 1) exactly 3 paragraphs, 2) under 180 words, 3) mention offline sync and end-to-end encryption, 4) no exclamation marks, 5) end with a call to action that includes the URL notes.example.com, 6) written for a business audience.
社内向けの障害報告書を書いてください。条件：①時系列は表形式、②原因・影響・暫定対応・恒久対策の4節、③影響ユーザー数は 1,240 人と明記、④敬体、⑤全体で800字以内、⑥最後に再発防止のチェックリストを箇条書きで5項目。

Create a weekly meal plan: 7 days, 3 meals each, vegetarian, no nuts, under 2,000 kcal per day with the calories listed per meal, a shopping list grouped by aisle, and no ingredient repeated more than three times in the week.

Draft an API design for a booking service: REST endpoints for create/read/cancel, idempotency keys, pagination with cursors, error codes as an RFC 7807 table, rate limits per tenant, and an OpenAPI 3.1 snippet for the create endpoint.

Write a Python function that parses ISO 8601 durations. It must support years through seconds, reject negative values, return a datetime.timedelta, raise ValueError with the offending token, include type hints and docstring, and come with pytest tests covering 8 cases.
採用面接の質問リストを作って：エンジニア職、技術質問10問・行動面接5問、各質問に評価観点を1行、日本語、Markdown の表、難易度を3段階で付ける。

Summarize the attached quarterly results for the board in five bullet points, each under 20 words, include revenue, gross margin and churn with their quarter-over-quarter change, and finish with one risk and one opportunity.

Q3: revenue $12.4M (Q2 $11.1M), gross margin 71% (Q2 69%), churn 2.9% (Q2 3.4%), new logos 41, net retention 112%.

Translate this privacy notice into formal Japanese, keep every section number, keep all legal terms consistent, do not translate product names, and add a glossary of five key terms at the end.

1. Data we collect: account data, usage data.
2. Purpose: providing the Service, security.
3. Retention: 24 months after account closure.
4. Your rights: access, rectification, erasure.
